title: Aggregating treatment effects across multiple outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2611.05456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Researchers often aggregate outcomes to estimate treatment effects on abstract concepts, such as "crime" or "wealth." First, I document that principal component analysis (PCA), inverse variance matrix (IVM) weighting, and standardized averaging (SA) are commonly used but have unexpected shortcomings. PCA can assign negative weights, need not maximize precision, depends on an arbitrary sign normalization, and can have nonstandard asymptotics. Unlike SA, IVM can assign negative weights, but neither necessarily maximizes precision. Second, I develop a statistical decision-theoretic approach that uses mean-squared error to choose nonnegative weights while accounting for outcome quality. I revisit a study on social distancing.

translated_title: 跨多个结果汇总处理效应
translated_abstract: 研究人员通常会汇总多个结果，以估计处理效应对抽象概念（如“犯罪”或“财富”）的影响。首先，我记录了主成分分析（PCA）、逆方差矩阵（IVM）加权和标准化平均（SA）这几种常用方法存在意想不到的缺陷。PCA可能分配负权重、不一定能最大化精度、依赖于任意的符号归一化，并且可能具有非标准的渐近性质。与标准化平均不同，IVM可能会分配负权重，但两者都不一定能最大化精度。其次，我开发了一种基于统计决策理论的方法，利用均方误差来选择非负权重，同时将结果的质量纳入考量。我重新审视了一项关于社交距离的研究。
tldr: 本文揭示了主成分分析、逆方差矩阵加权和标准化平均等常用结果汇总方法的缺陷，并提出了一种基于均方误差的统计决策理论方法，用以选择兼顾结果质量的非负权重来汇总处理效应。
en_tdlr: This paper documents the shortcomings of common outcome aggregation methods (PCA, inverse variance matrix weighting, and standardized averaging) and proposes a statistical decision-theoretic approach that uses mean-squared error to choose nonnegative weights while accounting for outcome quality.
